correctness.rationale: Exact jump solution proves the product saving formula. Positive and strictly concave D has one zero; strict concavity of logarithms gives unique interior maximum. Differentiation proves horizon response; Taylor expansions at the threshold and exponential tail balances give precise constants; the equal-rate case is algebraically exact. Reproducible independent numerical integration and randomized checks passed 108524 assertions. The independent simulation only supplements, not proves, universal statements.

value.rationale: A motivated indoor/outdoor pollution control tradeoff has an exact first-benefit cutoff and strict optimal timing. The two-rate long-horizon law exposes a discontinuity of the limiting optimal time fraction across environmental decay regimes and a noncommutation with vanishing outdoor amplitude. These results supply a useful benchmark for finite-duration air-exchange designs and warn against constant/mean outdoor background substitutions. This is not a calibrated household protocol or safety guidance.
